specs.title: SCN-004: A created booking can be read back unchanged

steps.title: Given I created a valid booking
[SEED] booking
When I GET /booking/{id}
Then the response status is 200
And the body equals the booking I created

steps.title: Given the id of a booking that no longer exists
[SEED] booking id that no longer exists
When I GET /booking/{id}
Then the response status is 404

specs.title: SCN-006: Searching by name finds the booking

steps.title: Given I created a valid booking with a unique first and last name
[SEED] booking
When I GET /booking with that firstname and lastname
Then the response status is 200
And the result contains the created booking id
